assumptions: Finite sorting tasks provide deterministic correctness metrics.
Step counts and call depth accurately measure process complexity.
definition.falsification: Sorting accuracy drops below 1.0 or non-deterministic behavior occurs under task decomposition.
definition.statement: Recursive sub-task branching in deterministic processes increases operational step complexity while maintaining complete functional accuracy on finite sorting tasks.
definition.uncertainty: Depth bounds and execution limits may constrain continuous complexity growth in bounded runtime environments.

convergence_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Depth bounds and execution limits may constrain continuous complexity growth in bounded runtime environments.
convergence_evidence.decision_rule: Compare the feasible next distinguishing test, expected uncertainty reduction and cost against the frozen stop rule. Budget exhaustion or administrative closure is not scientific resolution.

limits: Finite computational evidence does not establish a general theorem or natural-science discovery.
Closing an investigation is an administrative stop; its recorded scientific uncertainty remains.
Execution validity, measurement validity, model interpretation and replication are separate fields.
Token and monetary costs are unavailable unless a provider reports them; they are never inferred as zero.
